heroCopy: WHITEROCK's Vietnam factory is the primary production base, supported by OPTIMA STONE in Yunfu, China. Together they support drawing review, fabrication, quality checks, labeling, and shipment-ready packing.

capabilities.title: Cut-to-size & calibration
capabilities.copy: Straight cutting, thickness calibration, and repeat production. Final tolerance is confirmed by approved drawing and order specification.

capabilities.title: CNC fabrication
capabilities.copy: Sink cutouts, faucet/drain holes, drainboards, curved pieces, and shaped components from approved drawings.

capabilities.title: Edges & lamination
capabilities.copy: Eased, bevel, bullnose, ogee, mitered/laminated, waterfall, and approved custom profiles.

capabilities.title: Project production
capabilities.copy: Large-format and BOQ-based production with dimensional tolerance and flatness standards confirmed before production.

flowSteps.title: Material Selection
flowSteps.copy: Confirm category, color, thickness, finish, sample reference, slab lot, and traceability requirements.

flowSteps.title: Cutting & CNC
flowSteps.copy: Plan yield, cut to size, machine openings, and process approved shaped pieces.

flowSteps.title: Edge & Surface
flowSteps.copy: Complete profiles, lamination, polishing or honing, cleaning, and in-process checks.

flowSteps.title: Inspection & Export
flowSteps.copy: Check dimensions and finish, label pieces, protect edges, crate, and plan container loading.

qc.aql: Sampling plan confirmed per order or buyer inspection requirement.
qc.tools: Calipers, gauges, templates, and flatness tools used for routine dimensional checks; full tool list pending owner confirmation.
qc.thirdParty: Third-party inspection by SGS, Bureau Veritas, Intertek, or a buyer-appointed inspector is welcome by arrangement.

capabilities: 3D modeling / shop drawings support; software and team size pending owner confirmation
rnd.sampleLeadTime: Confirmed by sample scope and material availability

materials.copy: Material lots are reviewed against the approved sample and order requirements. Natural stone variation is documented by lot; engineered materials are sourced against the approved color and specification.
materials.traceability: Lot coding and repeat-order traceability are documented during order review; final process details pending owner confirmation.

packing.copy: Packing routes can include foam, corner guards, inner cartons, labeled plywood crates, pallets, or A-frames according to product weight and shipment method.
packing.loadability: Container loadability and pieces per crate are confirmed per SKU and drawing; final load plans are issued before shipment.
